Findings:
  WARNING   drive.missing  missing
            Present: the drive was not found in 2 runs in a row; last seen
            2026-10-03T12:34:12Z as /dev/sdb

What to do:
  If the drive was removed or replaced on purpose, nothing needs to be done.
  Otherwise check whether it failed, and look at the kernel log (journalctl
  -k).

This is the only notification about the missing drive. If it returns, its
findings are evaluated as usual. To adjust or silence this check for this
drive, see /etc/pve-smart-alert/config.toml.
